ownership: One supervisor process owns existing DB flock; all writers are non-daemon threads with factory-created/closed SQLite stores, mutable engines and providers inside their own threads. Constructor DDL serialized only.
lane_dependency_contract: LinkWorker(lane=source|maintenance,source_first=True,claim_observer=callback). callback(event=claimed|released,kind=source|derived|name,identity,token), at most one actual claim per run_once. Lane implementation/publication fences are separate sibling units, not included in this patch.
recovery: Existing source seven-line recovery plus derived/name recover_abandoned once under exclusive flock, before any lane starts. No repeated recovery across idle handshake epochs.
heartbeat: Main supervisor own connection/transaction renews ONLY registered exact identity+token rows with running status and unexpired lease. Default heartbeat30sec and TTL300sec. Continues during graceful stop/drain/join. Revoked/expired tokens never resurrected.
shutdown: Stop new budget reservations; join all active threads with ongoing heartbeat; only then idle unlock/probe/reacquire. Fatal lane or supervisor exception still joins; exception re-raised after closure. Process death kills writing threads.
budget: worker_limit is one global completed-turn budget, reservations cap concurrent claims; remaining budget retained across idle race/reacquire epochs. No per-thread multiplication.

verification.actual_run_worker_source_parallelism: 2 simultaneous source extraction calls, distinct thread-bound provider/store instances, conditional synthetic source text retained
verification.actual_heartbeat: source lease0.15s vs providerwait0.35s, main heartbeat0.01s, both jobs completed without lease loss

quality_boundary: No external model/network/private/prod/campus calls. Controlled-latency test preserves exact conditional payloads; timing is measurement, not flaky correctness assertion or model quality claim.
